description: Someone has pasted this square over half a cracked departure board, and nobody's dared peel it. A lone figure stands at the apex of a wireframe pyramid built of smaller figures, arms flung wide, triumphant. THE STRONG ORGANISE. THE REST WAIT FOR A TRAIN THAT ISN'T COMING. In smaller type: "Alone, you're a statistic. In a Corp, you're a shareholder. Claim ground. Hold it. Make the map say your name."
name: a recruitment poster plastered over the departure boards
